notes: Only some reserves have pick-up collectibles: artifacts and antler sheds in Hirschfelden, Layton Lake District and Medved-Taiga, artifacts in Vurhonga Savanna, and challenge targets in Parque Fernando. Counts come from a series of Steam guides by Nucta Ox; several were later removed from Steam but the pages could still be read. None of the guides, the Steam store pages or the achievement lists mention beer bottles in Hirschfelden, carved figures in Layton or rune stones in Revontuli, so those types are left out. Only Medved-Taiga and Parque Fernando have collectible achievements; Steam has no collectible achievements for the later reserves. Sundarpatan and Tòrr nan Sìthean guides exist but could not be fetched. Salzwiesen Park and Intisuyu: no data found.
